reason: Independent current-hash audit confirms the N>=1 test seminorm, nonempty full Schwartz unit class, and direct cone-supremum definition. The direct formula uses the Schwartz convolution and dilation definitions, so every F_N test, including zero-integral tests, gives a defined scalar; the extended-valued supremum is valid and the nesting of test classes makes higher-order grand maximal functions pointwise no larger. The base radial/nontangential definition remains restricted to admissible kernels and is not used outside that domain. Both current in-run suppliers (radial/nontangential definition and Schwartz dilation lemma) are closed, and the remaining direct dependencies are published.
